iut_type: Bluetooth module-based product, proxy registration service (new customer)
customer_question: Since our company has no prior transaction history with you, must we pay before work begins (pre-payment)? And if payment is made first, what is the resulting lead time to completion?
question_variants: Do new customers need to pay before any work starts?
What is the full schedule from payment to Compliance Folder delivery?
If we wire the payment first, when can we expect registration and Compliance Folder completion?
Why is pre-payment required for first-time customers?
actual_issue: The customer had no prior transaction history with the consulting company, and asked whether pre-payment (paying before any work begins) was required, and if so, what the resulting lead time to full completion (registration plus Compliance Folder) would be.
plain_english_explanation: Because this was the customer's first transaction with the consultant's company, the consultant required pre-payment before starting any proxy work — this is standard practice for new customers with no transaction history. The consultant then laid out the full process timeline: customer orders and wires payment, customer submits the invoice needed for the consultant's proxy wire transfer to SIG (1-2 business days), the consultant arranges the wire transfer to SIG (about 3 weeks until funds are received by SIG), the consultant completes proxy registration once given login access (1-3 business days), the customer submits documents needed for the Compliance Folder (1-3 business days), and the consultant creates and delivers the Compliance Folder (1-3 business days) — a total of about one month or more from payment.
consultant_answer: Since there is no prior transaction history between our companies, work will begin only after your company's wire transfer (pre-payment). The expected timeline from order/payment to completion: your payment and invoice submission (1-2 business days) -> our wire transfer arrangement and completion (about 3 weeks until funds reach SIG) -> proxy registration completion once you provide login account access (1-3 business days) -> your submission of documents needed for the Compliance Folder (1-3 business days) -> Compliance Folder creation and delivery (1-3 business days). Total: approximately one month or more.
decision_logic: For customers with no prior transaction history, require pre-payment before starting proxy registration or wire-transfer work. Communicate the full lead-time chain explicitly (payment -> invoice submission -> SIG wire transfer ~3 weeks -> proxy registration 1-3 business days -> Compliance Folder document submission and creation 1-3 business days each) so the customer can plan around the ~1 month total.
final_recommendation: State the pre-payment requirement and the full step-by-step lead-time schedule up front for any new customer with no transaction history, to avoid disputes about when payment is due relative to deliverables.
risk_if_done_wrong: Not clarifying the pre-payment requirement and lead-time chain up front with a new customer can cause scheduling disputes or distrust if the customer expects work to start before payment, or expects a faster turnaround than the SIG wire-transfer process allows.
